title: Finite circuit: coherent triple escapes pair-stationary k8 gauges, with exact restricted closure
body:
PR1310's pair-stationary gauge admits exactly one improving common-shift triple: L354/L469/L478 shifted by −1 forward (+1 backward). It saves two real-component primitives and unlocks another two at L257. The fully priced finite candidate uses **135,988 / 136,004 complex primitives**, eight fewer per orientation than PR1310, with every boundary scale included.

The primary result is the exact restricted census: all 2,190,670 three-helper subsets are covered by 49,898 connected triples plus a proved disconnected-component reduction at the initial/final stationary vectors. Two strict steps terminate with no improving common integer shift on any subset of size at most three. The intermediate vector is not claimed exhaustively screened over disconnected triples. This is **not arbitrary three-coordinate optimality, global optimality, or a new κ**; arbitrary pair stationarity is not asserted at the final vector. The paid recursive histogram is unchanged.

Validation:

- Registered Python 3.12.13 replay and optimized Python 3.14 read-only relocation: seven test groups pass.
- Separate direct-cut/literal-lowerer oracle: 9,684,524 dense integer evaluations, complete initial/final pair/triple minima in both orientations; independently enumerates all labeled triples for connectivity.
- Complete 712-column scalar endpoints, separate word reconstruction, six arbitrary-dirty literal-primitive fixtures, full costs and local prefix/grid checks.
- Synthetic exhaustive graphs, omitted/inverted boundary and coefficient faults, source/receipt corruption controls; 45 repository research/selected tests pass with one existing skip.
- Source pins, package metadata and selected baseline checks pass. No full selected cold replay, native/hosted integration, hosted-CI-success or independent human review claim.

Reproduce: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/k8-coherent-triples`.

Base `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; PR1310 pinned at `b9ca10f02fca37c8214d880c244ac14ead6bae7a`. OS-random seed37, complex-supplier track. Complete live PR/discussion overlap checks and the original unique-triple result are recorded in the package. Selected frontier, upstream and existing packages are unchanged.

Credit Hanson Sun / bbMisk (PR1214), woklerx (PR1161), Sagar Thakrar (PR696/1259), Philipp / mightyOil (PR1263/1310), Jeremy Kothe, Rohan Arun, Hao Yan / icekylinx, Douglas Colkitt and the retained lineage. Source extraction, eligibility, formal replay and invoice are explicitly reused, while the second oracle uses the retained separate PR1263 interpreter. Prepared for Philipp (@mightyOil) with substantial OpenAI Codex / GPT-6 Astra assistance in mathematics, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0; no mechanism-priority claim.
